questions.stem: A 36-year-old patient was posted for surgery. He was given glycopyrrolate before anesthesia. What is the rationale for giving glycopyrrolate before anesthesia?
questions.solutionHtml:
To decrease secretions
  • Glycopyrrolate has antagonistic action on M3 receptors present in glands like salivary and tracheobronchial glands and decreases their secretions so it is used as pre-anesthetic medication.
  • Glycopyrrolate is used as a pre-anesthetic medication to decrease salivary, tracheobronchial, pharyngeal, and gastric secretions (a quaternary compound that does not cross BBB)


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 130

questions.stem: A patient came in with bradycardia and was given atropine. Which of the following is not seen with atropine given to this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Contraction of sphincter pupillae
  • Atropine is parasympatholytic with antagonist action on M1, M2, and M3 receptors. So, it causes mydriasis.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 154, 155

questions.stem: A 76-year-old male patient was taking Haloperidol for schizophrenia for the last 2 months. Now he comes to the clinic with symptoms like bradykinesia, muscle rigidity, and gait abnormality. Which of the following drugs will help in the treatment of these patients’ new symptoms?
questions.solutionHtml:
Benzhexol
  • This is a case of drug-induced Parkinson's disease, due to D2 blockade by haloperidol


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 128, 129, 460

questions.stem: A 30-year-old male presented in the OPD with complaints of increased frequency in micturition. Also, sudden urge to micturate which is difficult. He has advised antibiotics along with another drug. What can be the most likely drug which is advised for this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Flavoxate
  • In UTI, patients may have overactive bladders and to prevent frequent and sudden urge to urinate, anticholinergic drugs can be used.
  • In the given options, it is flavoxate which is anticholinergic used in overactive bladder
